ada.text: Good morning, everyone! My errand today took me across the green to the orchard, where the blossoms were just opening. I keep bees, so I always check which trees the bees will favour this season. Then I hurried here to the pond hall to share it with you. Now I'd love to hear how your mornings went.

bo.text: Um... hi, everyone. This morning I planned to walk to the orchard, but the plan changed, so I came here to the pond hall instead. I think I'm glad. It's a quiet place, and I'd rather play my music here, softly, than hurry somewhere else.
